input.description: Check repo status and top-level files

input.command: find . -maxdepth 3 -name "*.py" -o -maxdepth 3 -name "conftest.py" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50; echo "---pytest config---"; ls -la | grep -iE "pytest|setup.py|pyproject|tox"; echo "---git log---"; git log --oneline -3
